searchText: The in-place upgrade functionality I am using SELFDESTRUCT for can be achieved with a SETCODE opcode. I already started a spec for it a couple years ago. If SETCODE is added in the same upgrade that SELFDESTRUCT is broken, that would be ideal for me.

excerpts.author: wjmelements
